title: Can Neural Networks Learn by Experimenting on Themselves? Self-Interventional Learning from Functional Consequences to Predictive Self-Knowledge
abstract: arXiv:2608.14894v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Machine-learning systems usually model external data, while their internal functional organization is analyzed by external observers. This work introduces Self-Interventional Learning (SIL), in which a neural system perturbs its own functional structure, observes consequences, learns a predictive self-model, generalizes to unexecuted interventions, and uses predictions to guide later structural action. In a construction-known synthetic system, SIL recovered critical structure, redundancy, and replaceability, while synergy was not reliably recovered. Across 30 fresh confirmatory seeds, increasing the pairwise intervention budget from 4 to 56 reduced held-out prediction error from 0.0335 to 0.0148 and increased Spearman correlation from 0.629 to 0.883. In a matched ablation, preserving the correct intervention--consequence mapping reduced prospective prediction error by 81.3%, while using the same learned self-model for action reduced norm

translated_title: 神经网络能否通过自我实验进行学习？从功能后果到预测性自我知识的自我干预学习
translated_abstract: 机器学习系统通常对外部数据进行建模，而其内部功能组织则由外部观察者分析。本研究引入了自我干预学习（SIL），在该框架中，神经系统的模型会扰动自身功能结构，观察后果，学习预测性自我模型，泛化到未执行的干预，并利用预测指导后续的结构性行动。在一个结构已知的合成系统中，SIL成功恢复了关键结构、冗余性和可替换性，但协同性未能可靠恢复。在30个新的确认种子实验中，将成对干预预算从4增加到56，将留出预测误差从0.0335降至0.0148，并将Spearman相关性从0.629提高到0.883。在匹配的消融实验中，保留正确的干预-后果映射将前瞻性预测误差降低了81.3%，而使用相同的学习自我模型进行行动则将范数降低了。
tldr: 本文提出自我干预学习（SIL），让神经网络通过自我扰动和观察后果来学习预测性自我模型，并证明该方法能有效恢复系统结构并显著提升干预预测准确性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Self-Interventional Learning (SIL), where neural networks perturb their own structure, observe consequences, and learn predictive self-models, demonstrating effective recovery of system structure and significant improvements in intervention prediction accuracy.
